patterns.note: Sections frequently pair a prominent, full-width data visualization graphic with concise textual explanations, often in a two-column arrangement.

Headings utilize a modern, slightly condensed sans-serif for impact, while body text employs a clean, highly readable sans-serif, complemented by smaller, often uppercase, labels for sub-sections and navigation.

A vibrant, data-driven palette of teal, orange, and various blues is consistently used for graphics and section backgrounds, providing strong contrast against a clean white base and black text, with red reserved for primary calls to action and the logo.
The header transforms on scroll, shrinking in height and changing from a transparent background with light text to a solid white background with dark text and a red logo.

The site uses full-width sections with distinct, often patterned or gradient, background colors to clearly delineate content blocks, frequently featuring large, illustrative data visualizations as the primary visual element.

technique_notes: The header transitions from a transparent, full-height state with light text to a condensed, solid white background with dark text and a colored logo upon scroll, creating a sticky navigation effect.

The hero section incorporates a large, complex data visualization that functions as a dynamic hero element, likely using CSS keyframe animations or an embedded video to showcase interactivity and data points.
Sections are visually separated by alternating background colors, often featuring vibrant, full-bleed graphics or patterns that extend across the width of the page to create distinct content zones.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold, modern sans-serif headings (approx. 3-4x body text) paired with clean, readable sans-serif body text and smaller, often uppercase, labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle (buttons, cards, and input fields have a slight border-radius of a few pixels).
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and within the hero, but a denser grid for feature icons and footer links.

standout: The site's distinctive use of vibrant, complex, and often interactive data visualizations as core design elements, integrated seamlessly into the layout rather than just static images. This creates a strong sense of authority and capability in data presentation, making the product itself the hero of the design.
